entries.conditions: LiteRT 2.3.0 CompiledModel on the CPU through the C API of the ai-edge-litert 2.3.0 wheel (Mac Studio M4 Max), XNNPACK options flags = 7 (the default 3 plus FP16 = 4, set through the CPU options' TOML), a one-op graph y = x @ C with C a constant table: 'failed to delegate BATCH_MATMUL node #0', 'Node number 1 (TfLiteXNNPackDelegate) failed to prepare.', 'Failed to allocate tensors', then LiteRtRunCompiledModel status 3 (kLiteRtStatusErrorRuntimeFailure); the CPU fallback does not rescue it. The same graph with flags 3 delegates (kernel tag 'Batch Matrix Multiply (NC, PF32)'); the same op with the second input as a graph input delegates under flags 7 ('Batch Matrix Multiply (NC, PF16)'). The full conformers of the model fail the same way at their first constant-table BATCH_MATMUL (float32 graph node #51, float16-weight graph node #58).

evidence.source_model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b @ea30d66d: the one-op control bmm_constB.tflite (scripts/r3_bmm_ctl.py), the shape of the conformer's relative-position BATCH_MATMUL

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: measured: the rewritten conformer runs under flags 7 with 4,090 of its 4,093 nodes in one XNNPACK partition and every XNNPACK kernel tag float16 (PF16 316, X16 576, F16 48); on the phones the same graph without flags 7 takes 102.84 % (Galaxy S26) and 109.93 % (Pixel 11 Pro) longer per chunk
rewrite_hints.rewrite: write each matmul with a constant table as FULLY_CONNECTED (the table as its weights, a bias as a separate ADD)
rewrite_hints.symptom: the model does not run when XNNPACK is asked for float16 arithmetic

entries.conditions: ai-edge-litert 2.3.0 Interpreter with its default XNNPACK delegate (Mac Studio M4 Max), the model's conformer graphs (float32, float16-weight, int8- and int4-weight forms): the graph's last three nodes, CONCATENATION with 24 FLOAT32 inputs each (the 24 layers' k / v / conv caches stacked into the outputs k_out and v_out [24, 8, 56, 128] and conv_out [24, 1024, 8]), stay outside the single XNNPACK partition (3,870 of 3,873 nodes delegated in the float32 graph) and run on LiteRT's built-in kernel; the model runs. The same three nodes stay outside on the phones' CPU (LiteRT 2.3.0 C API runner on the Galaxy S26 and the Pixel 11 Pro: 4,090 of 4,093 for the FULLY_CONNECTED-rewritten float16 graph).

evidence.source_model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b @ea30d66d, the conformer graphs (published as nemotron_asr_conformer_f32.tflite and its float16-weight forms)

rewrite_hints.symptom: 3 nodes run outside the XNNPACK partition
